title: Split provider manager bucket assembly and accessors into a reusable capability bucket boundary
description: ProviderManager already has per-capability routing modules, but from_configs still repeats build/default-selection/accessor logic for every bucket. Introduce a reusable provider bucket helper so future capability additions or dashboard mutations do not grow manager.rs directly.

files.change: Own provider map, default selection, count, and lookup patterns shared across capability buckets.
Delegate repeated per-capability assembly/accessor mechanics to the bucket helper while preserving public methods.

criteria: ProviderManager public behavior and default fallback remain unchanged.
Capability-specific modules keep trait-specific routing while shared bucket logic removes repeated map/default code.
No provider selection change-hook behavior is introduced here; TASK-042 remains separate.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-provider && cargo clippy -p astrbot-provider -- -D warnings
